description: Provenance of the vendored Fermix wire contracts. The canonical files live in the fermix repository under apps/fermix_core/priv/; this tree is a byte-identical copy pinned by CHECKSUMS.txt. scripts/verify_protocol_contract.sh asserts the two agree, and --source <fermix-checkout> byte-compares against upstream.

contracts.name: management
contracts.provenance_note: Taken from the fermix repository at 3f5b6afd, the merge commit of engine pull request #90 on dev; origin carries that branch, so committed_upstream is true. Every file is byte for byte the export at f9ff0152, the v0.11.0 release the app pins and the previous provenance, which carried the engine's on-device transcription fix: PROTOCOL.md now says a disabled settings option is shown unselectable with its hint, which is never null and says why, that settings.apply refuses a disabled value with that same sentence, and that today the two transcription backend rows publish one, local, on a machine the build has no on-device speech engine for; and the two settings.get goldens, transcription and meetings, label the local transcription option On this device instead of On this Mac. The option's disabled and hint fields were already in the schema, so protocol 2, the 1 to 2 window and the 42 method minimums are the ones it carried: a disabled option is a value inside a row settings.get already returns, not a method or a field. As at the previous pin, it carries the Venice provider, as its own settings section and as a row in setup.state.get; the info field on every settings row, a string or null, which is the longer explanation a surface keeps behind an info control and which one row publishes today, Venice's model row; the sandbox section's one row per environment variable name, keyed env:<NAME>, a secret row where Fermix can store the value and a read-only text row where it cannot or where the value comes from a helper command or another variable, with restart false on the allowed names row and on every name row; the fifth secret id family, env:<NAME>, on secret.set and secret.clear; two advisory readiness failures for allowed sandbox environment variables the daemon cannot read, sandbox:env_missing and sandbox:env_helper_failed, both under the sandbox pane; and the computer use section's second row, work inside one window. Each of these is a row, a field or a failure inside a method that already exists, and env:<NAME> is an open id family on two existing methods rather than a method of its own, so none moved a method minimum. The goldens' sample hosted plugin is the fictional acme, because the engine retired Eden.

contracts.name: realtime
contracts.provenance_note: Taken from the same commit, 3f5b6afd, the merge commit of engine pull request #90 on dev. One file changed since f9ff0152, the v0.11.0 release the app pins and the previous provenance: PROTOCOL.md gains twelve lines from the engine's Live relay fix. Live publishes no turn boundaries, so the daemon now reads the turn from the audio it relays and sends state thinking once the microphone, having carried speech, has been quiet for a moment with no reply started, and state listening once a reply's audio has had time to play out, both for the pet's presentation only, and the Live call sequence shows those two frames; and because Live cannot cancel a reply, an interrupt stops it at the relay, where the daemon answers playback_stop and state listening and forwards none of the rest of that reply. The schema and both fixture files are byte for byte v0.11.0's: thinking and listening were already documented state values and interrupt and playback_stop already frames, which the daemon now sends in more places, so the protocol stays 2 on the 1 to 2 window. Protocol 2 is the one that added the frames the Live engine needs: task_cancel from the pet, call_ready, caption and task from the daemon, the Live fields on usage, and kind, detail and required_for on error. The window is 1 to 2, so a pet speaking 1 still runs the Realtime engine against this daemon.

contracts.name: companion
contracts.provenance_note: Taken from the same commit, 3f5b6afd, the merge commit of engine pull request #90 on dev; this is the tree's first pin. The companion chat wire is newline-delimited JSON on companion.sock in the Fermix home, mode 0600, at most four connections, opened by the same one-shot client_hello and server_hello handshake as the realtime socket, and it carries the chat vocabulary the mobile wire already speaks (msg, command, accepted, the turn's text_delta, tool_event, text_done and turn_error, approval and approval_resolved, read_state) plus cancel naming its request, history_search with search_results, a row announcement for every timeline row written outside a turn's completion, and a backward cursor on history_pull and history_page. The timeline, its server_seq numbering and its read frontier are the ones the phone shares, msg and command are at least once behind a durable accepted receipt keyed on client_msg_id, and the protocol is 1 on the 1 to 1 window.
